title: Perfect local lifting of a lisse residue reduction
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (locally Noetherian and quasi-compact) [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme, def-pc-scheme]. Let $(A,I)$ be an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and assume $A\xrightarrow{\sim}\varprojlim_{n\geq1}A/I^n$. Use sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and inverse limits of sheaves [def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit]. Put $B_X=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/I^n)_X$ on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $M\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(B_X))$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] be derived $I$-complete [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion]. Suppose $M_1=M\otimes^L_{B_X}(A/I)_X$ [def-weil-derived-tensor] is etale locally on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] isomorphic to the constant complex of a perfect $A/I$-complex: there is an etale covering on each member of which $M_1$ is isomorphic, after pullback to the pro-etale site, to a bounded complex of constant sheaves of finite projective $A/I$-modules [def-weil-pbc-projective-module]. Then there is a pro-etale covering $\{U_j\to X\}$ and perfect $A$-complexes $P_j$ [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex], meaning bounded complexes of finite projective $A$-modules, with $M|_{U_j}\simeq B_X|_{U_j}\otimes_A^L P_j$. Here tensor with $A$ means tensor with its constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and restriction is to the corresponding localized site. No stratification or compatible etale witnesses are asserted in this conclusion.
